title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 10: Saul is anointed by Samuel, prophesies among the prophets, and is chosen king at Mizpah.

questions.text: What did Samuel pour on Saul's head?
questions.explanation: Samuel took the vial of oil, poured it on his head, and kissed him.

questions.text: Where did Samuel say Saul would find two men?
questions.explanation: Samuel said Saul would find two men by Rachel's tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah.

questions.text: How many loaves of bread would the three men at the oak of Tabor give Saul?
questions.explanation: Samuel said they would greet him and give him two loaves of bread.

questions.text: How long was Saul to wait at Gilgal until Samuel came?
questions.explanation: Samuel said, "Wait seven days, until I come to you, and show you what you are to do."

questions.text: What saying became a proverb when Saul prophesied?
questions.explanation: When people saw him prophesying, it became a proverb: "Is Saul also among the prophets?"

questions.text: What did Saul not tell his uncle?
questions.explanation: Saul told his uncle the donkeys were found, but did not tell him about the matter of the kingdom.

answers.text: That the donkeys had been found
The matter of the kingdom Samuel spoke of

questions.text: Where was Saul hiding when he was chosen and could not be found?
questions.explanation: Yahweh answered, "Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage."

questions.text: What did all the people shout when Samuel presented Saul?
questions.explanation: All the people shouted, "Long live the king!"

questions.text: To which town did Saul go to his house?
questions.explanation: Saul also went to his house to Gibeah, and the army whose hearts God had touched went with him.

questions.text: How did Saul respond when certain worthless fellows despised him?
questions.explanation: They despised him and brought him no present, but he held his peace.

answers.text: He had them put to death
He sent them out of Israel
He demanded a present from them
